title: Encapsulate FidelityManager mutable state
objective: Close the source-only capability gap where FidelityManager exposes replaceable config and mutable _states/_metrics on its public manager table, allowing callers to bypass validated transition/accounting boundaries, while preserving the existing F0-F4 API and policy semantics.
acceptance: the public Manager facade does not expose mutable manager-owned config, entity-state storage, aggregate counters, or transition-fence state as caller-writable authority
preserve the existing public FidelityManager methods, F0-F4 policy outputs, reasons, hysteresis, hold/cooldown behavior, registration semantics, and metrics snapshot shape
caller-provided PolicyConfig remains validated, copied, and frozen, and the effective manager-owned config cannot be replaced after construction through the returned facade
direct caller writes attempted through any/dynamic access cannot forge observed fidelity, registered/count metrics, capacity state, pending state, clocks, or transitioning state
use a bounded production-worthy encapsulation seam such as closure-private weak-key manager state plus a frozen public facade; do not introduce a competing manager framework
state lifetime remains bounded by the existing registration ceiling and does not gain an unbounded strong-reference cache; if weak-key backing is used, add lifecycle coverage for released facades

retain all accepted regressions from #385, #398, and #419 including malformed-input no-execute behavior, rejected-step atomicity, per-entity reentrancy, cross-entity commit isolation, and the project-owned registration ceiling
add adversarial source/runtime regressions for facade mutation attempts and immediate valid operation afterward
canonical CI, live pr-ownership, and fresh independent exact-head review are required before integration
source-only lane: no Roblox Studio, viewport, physical-contact, performance-device, or two-client evidence claim
notes: Capacity-mined against retained Fidelity source PR #419 exact head 1f017628bf49365663dfc2db3a30b81ba477a0a3. ManagerImpl still stores config/_states/_metrics directly on the returned mutable manager table and new() returns setmetatable(self, FidelityManager) without a frozen facade or closure-private backing. Existing PhysicsLabRuntime synthesis PR #408 demonstrates a compatible weak-key closure-private state + frozen-facade pattern. This leaf is intentionally PROPOSED and depends on both retained Fidelity transition work and the capacity-ceiling lineage reaching DONE.
